# Niva

> Niva is an open-source Rust desktop app runtime with developer tools for packaging web-based applications on macOS and Windows. The documentation is in Simplified Chinese.

Use the matching `Niva.<namespace>` link below to find methods. Repository documents marked as plans are not implemented features; check the source and release status before claiming platform support or security acceptance.

## Getting started

- [Overview](https://bramblex.github.io/niva/docs/intro): What Niva and its Devtools provide.
- [Create a project](https://bramblex.github.io/niva/docs/tutorial/new-project): Create and run a basic Niva project.
- [Import a project](https://bramblex.github.io/niva/docs/tutorial/import-project): Bring an existing frontend project into Niva.

## Project configuration

- [Project options](https://bramblex.github.io/niva/docs/options/project): niva.json structure and core settings.
- [Window options](https://bramblex.github.io/niva/docs/options/window): Window configuration.
- [Menu options](https://bramblex.github.io/niva/docs/options/menu): Application and window menu configuration.
- [Tray options](https://bramblex.github.io/niva/docs/options/tray): System tray configuration.
- [Shortcut options](https://bramblex.github.io/niva/docs/options/shortcut): Global shortcut configuration.

## API entry points and bridge

- [Niva API overview](https://bramblex.github.io/niva/docs/api/niva): API namespaces and basic calls.
- [Bridge and calls](https://bramblex.github.io/niva/docs/api/bridge): JavaScript/native transport and wire protocol.
- [Remote page permissions](https://bramblex.github.io/niva/docs/api/permissions): Permission configuration and current validation boundary.
- [Streaming and binary data](https://bramblex.github.io/niva/docs/api/stream): Stream call lifecycle and payloads.

## Niva namespaces

- [Niva.clipboard](https://bramblex.github.io/niva/docs/api/clipboard): Read and write clipboard data.
- [Niva.dialog](https://bramblex.github.io/niva/docs/api/dialog): Native file and message dialogs.
- [Niva.extra](https://bramblex.github.io/niva/docs/api/extra): Additional system methods.
- [Niva.fs](https://bramblex.github.io/niva/docs/api/fs): File system access and streaming.
- [Niva.monitor](https://bramblex.github.io/niva/docs/api/monitor): Display information.
- [Niva.os](https://bramblex.github.io/niva/docs/api/os): Operating system information and paths.
- [Niva.process](https://bramblex.github.io/niva/docs/api/process): Process information, execution, and streams.
- [Niva.resource](https://bramblex.github.io/niva/docs/api/resource): Bundled resource access.
- [Niva.shortcut](https://bramblex.github.io/niva/docs/api/shortcut): Global shortcuts.
- [Niva.tray](https://bramblex.github.io/niva/docs/api/tray): System tray controls.
- [Niva.webview](https://bramblex.github.io/niva/docs/api/webview): WebView controls.
- [Niva.window](https://bramblex.github.io/niva/docs/api/window): Window controls.
- [Niva.windowExtra](https://bramblex.github.io/niva/docs/api/window_extra): Platform-specific window controls.
- [Events](https://bramblex.github.io/niva/docs/event): Window, menu, tray, shortcut, and file-drop events.

## Optional

- [NodeCompat](https://bramblex.github.io/niva/docs/api/node-compat): Embedded Node-shaped browser modules, enabled by default, with API and platform limits.
- [NodeCompat HTTP and HTTPS](https://bramblex.github.io/niva/docs/api/http): Node-style HTTP clients and application servers; these are modules, not Niva namespaces.
- [stdio host bridge](https://bramblex.github.io/niva/docs/api/stdio): Host messaging and protocol limits.
- [Type declarations](https://github.com/bramblex/niva/blob/main/packages/types/Niva_zh.d.ts): Public TypeScript API signatures.
- [Source code](https://github.com/bramblex/niva): Source of truth for current behavior.
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/bramblex/niva/blob/main/docs/roadmap.md): Open work and proposed features; not a list of delivered capabilities.

Architecture update: APIs live directly on Niva. injectCommonJs and injectEsm independently opt into Node globals and browser ESM facades. Niva.bridge owns transport; Niva.stream is the Node module. process stdio is main-window-only; there is no --stdio or api.host protocol. See repository architecture-implementation-plan.md for current implementation and evidence boundaries.
